# CoSec

> Multi-tenant, non-blocking authorization framework for Spring Boot (WebFlux, MVC, Spring Cloud Gateway). Policies are JSON documents (platform, app and tenant) with bindings, compiled into a snapshot every instance reads from Redis; decisions are deny-first and fail closed. JWT and API key authentication with always-on token revocation, rate limits as document rules, and a control plane for reviewed changes, simulation and rollback. Kotlin, Java 21, Spring Boot 4.

Key facts: any matching DENY overrides every ALLOW; a request nothing allows is denied; a request that cannot be decided (a document that does not compile or cannot be read, an unavailable attribute or membership source) is answered 503. Denied anonymous callers get 401, authenticated ones 403, exceeded rate limit rules 429; every error body is `application/problem+json`. Statements use `service:verb` actions (from a route map) or `http:<METHOD>`, typed or `http:path:` resources, and condition ASTs such as `{"eq": ["subject.authenticated", true]}`.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/introduction): what CoSec is, what it decides, the modules and what each needs next to the starter
- [Quick Start](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/quick-start): dependency, configuration, the first platform document, issuing a token, the first denied request
- [Concepts](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/concepts): principals, tenants, apps and spaces, documents, policies and statements, bindings, memberships, the snapshot, decisions
- [Security Model](https://cosec.ahoo.me/guide/security-model): the decision algorithm (candidates, deny-first, default deny, Indeterminate, boundaries, break-glass), fail closed and its exceptions, trust boundaries

## Integration

- [Web Integration](https://cosec.ahoo.me/integration/web): choosing an adapter (WebFlux, MVC, Gateway), outcomes and HTTP statuses, problem+json bodies, `CoSec-*` parameters, the security context, client IP behind proxies, CORS
- [Authentication](https://cosec.ahoo.me/integration/authentication): JWT tokens and their membership claims, membership providers, login, refresh, logout and always-on revocation, API keys, authenticators, social login
- [Checks in Code](https://cosec.ahoo.me/integration/checks): checking permissions from code (AuthorizationChecker), explaining a decision through the control plane

## Policies

- [Policy Language](https://cosec.ahoo.me/policies/language): reference for every document field: platform, app and tenant documents, policies, statements, actions, resources, condition ASTs, bindings, catalogs, rate limit rules, limits, external attributes, JSON Schema
- [Role Permissions](https://cosec.ahoo.me/policies/role-permissions): app permission catalogs, permission policies, role bindings, space scoping
- [Rate Limiting](https://cosec.ahoo.me/policies/rate-limiting): rate limit rules as document obligations, keys and buckets, Redis or per-instance counting, 429 and RateLimit headers, failure behavior
- [Testing Policies](https://cosec.ahoo.me/policies/testing): changes through the control plane: validation, simulate, shadow windows, approval, access analysis, publishing

## Operations

- [Configuration](https://cosec.ahoo.me/operations/configuration): every `cosec.*` property with its default
- [Storage and Caching](https://cosec.ahoo.me/operations/storage): snapshot documents in Redis, the `noeviction` requirement, publishing (control plane, `cosec-migrate`), revisions and rollback, behavior when Redis is unavailable
- [Upgrading](https://cosec.ahoo.me/operations/upgrading): breaking changes and migration steps per version, including 7.x to 8.0 with `cosec-migrate`
- [Observability](https://cosec.ahoo.me/operations/observability): decision listeners, audit events, OpenTelemetry spans, Micrometer metrics, Kafka, logs
- [Troubleshooting](https://cosec.ahoo.me/operations/troubleshooting): problem types, diagnosing 400/401/403/429/503, documents that do not compile, snapshot lag, startup failures, rate limits

## Architecture

- [Overview](https://cosec.ahoo.me/architecture/overview): module layering, the request path through the pipeline, the engine and the snapshot, invariants and the tests that guard them, performance
- [Extending CoSec](https://cosec.ahoo.me/architecture/extending): attribute providers, membership providers, decision listeners, rate limiters, authenticators
